behaviors.description: Select the architecture of an architecture-unspecified flatpakref.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent repository advertises the same app and branch for native and foreign architectures.
behaviors.expected: Native/foreign/native default-architecture settings resolve exactly the selected full ref; aborting at ready leaves no deployments.

behaviors.description: Allow an already-installed ref only when reinstall is enabled.
behaviors.preconditions: Independently known app commit and runtime already installed.
behaviors.expected: Transactions with reinstall disabled fail ALREADY_INSTALLED before and after the enabled transaction succeeds; deployed and downloaded commits remain exact.

mappings.rationale: Opposing default architectures change resolution of an identical architecture-unspecified flatpakref.

surface_assertions.rationale: Resolved operation identity follows native/foreign/native settings and cannot remain on host default.

mappings.rationale: The same installed ref succeeds only with reinstall enabled between two disabled controls.

surface_assertions.rationale: An enabled reinstall succeeds where both disabled controls produce ALREADY_INSTALLED; exact commits are preserved.
